reset_password.title: Reset your password
reset_password.contents: Click the button below to create a new password for your account:
reset_password.footer: The link expires after 1 hour. If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email.

driver_document_expiring.title: Document {categoryName} expiring soon
driver_document_expiring.consequence: Please renew the document as soon as possible.
driver_document_expiring.footer: Ignoring this warning may result in work restrictions.

driver_document_expired.title: Document {categoryName} expired - action required
driver_document_expired.consequence: Your account may be restricted until renewal.

push_enabled.title: Push Notifications Enabled
push_enabled.body: You have successfully enabled push notifications for this device.

template_notification.title: Template Notification
template_notification.body: This is a template notification with custom data: {customField}

early_settlement_requested.title: New Early Settlement Request
early_settlement_requested.body: Driver {driverName} has requested an early settlement of {requestedAmount} PLN.
early_settlement_requested.consequence: Please review the request in the admin panel.

early_settlement_approved.title: Early Settlement Approved
early_settlement_approved.body: Your early settlement request for {requestedAmount} PLN has been approved.
early_settlement_approved.footer: If you have any questions, please contact the fleet administrator.

early_settlement_rejected.title: Early Settlement Rejected
early_settlement_rejected.body: Your early settlement request for {requestedAmount} PLN has been rejected.
early_settlement_rejected.footer: If you have any questions, please contact the fleet administrator.

vehicle_document_expiring.title: Vehicle document {categoryName} expiring soon
vehicle_document_expiring.body: The {categoryName} for vehicle {registrationNumber} expires in {daysUntilExpiry} days ({expiryDate}).
vehicle_document_expiring.consequence: Please renew the document as soon as possible.
vehicle_document_expiring.footer: Ignoring this warning may result in the vehicle being disabled.

vehicle_document_expired.title: Vehicle document {categoryName} expired - action required
vehicle_document_expired.consequence: Vehicle may be blocked until renewed.

vehicle_status_changed.title: Vehicle status changed to {newStatus}
vehicle_status_changed.body: Status of vehicle {registrationNumber} changed from {previousStatus} to {newStatus}. Reason: {reason}

handover_document_created.title: Vehicle Handover Protocol Created
handover_document_created.body: A vehicle handover and acceptance protocol ({categoryName}) has been created for vehicle {registrationNumber}.

handover_document_closed.title: Vehicle Handover Protocol Closed
handover_document_closed.body: The vehicle handover and acceptance protocol ({categoryName}) for vehicle {registrationNumber} has been closed.
